youtube_description:
I arrived early at the Gorge Amphitheater in Washington, so I checked out the local sights. This is Rattlesnake Cove on the Columbia River. Amazingly, no one else from the show was hanging out here. 

Subscribe to us here on YouTube for more 360 degree VR video hiking experiences. 

Everything else Ryan does can be found here: https://linktr.ee/Ryanmadlener

Check out my brother Neil's art portfolio: https://neilmadlener.com
